settings.content: Contrast is an accessibility requirement, not a preference. Text on background must reach 4.5:1 and UI components 3:1 (WCAG 2.2 AA).

settings.label: Muted text
settings.info: Must still reach 4.5:1 on the background.

settings.content: Two weights only. Each additional weight is another font file on the critical path.
Only state what can actually be honoured. Every promise here is repeated on product pages and becomes a contractual commitment.

settings.label: Guarantee name
settings.info: Name it and give it a number, e.g. "60-day court trial".

settings.label: Guarantee terms
settings.info: Include the exclusions. A guarantee with published exclusions is more credible, not less, and suppresses returns.

settings.label: Returns summary
settings.info: EU consumers have 14 days to withdraw without reason. State who pays return postage — if you do not say so in advance, you pay it.

settings.content: Required by EU distance-selling information duties. A Dutch trader must show KvK and btw numbers.
